items.title: Google Cloud Warns Three AMD Turin CPU Flaws Could Leak Data Across Processes in VMs
items.excerpt: Google Cloud VMs on AMD Turin chips need a guest OS patch and a stop-and-start to protect against three CPU side-channel flaws, Google said this week. The company has already applied mitigations against attacks between VMs, and between VMs and the host. items.title: Calendar Invites and Live Proxies: Inside a Google Session Hijacking Campaign
items.excerpt: Since mid-August 2026, a phishing operation has been stealing live Google sessions from corporate users. Every check defenders normally lean on to judge a link came back clean, and the operator designed it that way on purpose. The Threat Research team at Material Security spotted the campaign and has since taken down hundreds of attacker domains in an effort the team calls Operation CloudFire.

items.title: Microsoft 365 Outage Disrupts Outlook, Exchange Online and Teams
items.excerpt: Microsoft says failed server health checks disrupted Outlook and other Microsoft 365 services. The company is still investigating the cause and has disclosed no evidence of a cyberattack. The post Microsoft 365 Outage Disrupts Outlook, Exchange Online and Teams appeared first on SecurityWeek .

items.excerpt: The mod_http2 race condition, CVE-2026-119618, could let unauthenticated attackers execute code on servers with HTTP/2 enabled. The post Apache Patches Critical HTTP Server RCE Found by Anthropic, Google appeared first on SecurityWeek .

items.title: Attacker Targets 60,000 GitHub Repositories in Credential Theft Campaign
items.excerpt: Using thousands of hijacked accounts, the wfx-loot campaign planted a CI secret stealer that ran in over 1,800 GitHub repositories. The post Attacker Targets 60,000 GitHub Repositories in Credential Theft Campaign appeared first on SecurityWeek .
